teaser.en: A wild cucumber of the bush, its small spiny fruits looking edible but carrying a name that warns otherwise.
teaser.sw: Tango la porini la vichakani; matunda yake madogo yenye miiba yanaonekana kuliwa, lakini jina lake linaonya vinginevyo.
teaser.dg: Mtango wa weruni, ambao matundage madide genye miya ganaonekana dza ganafwaha kuriwa, ela dzinare rinaonya kukala sivyo.

summary.en: Mtango koma is a wild Cucumis, a trailing relative of the cucumber and melon. Pakia records only its name and identifies it to genus.
summary.sw: Mtango koma ni mmea wa porini wa jenasi Cucumis, jamaa anayetambaa wa mtango na tikiti. Pakia anarekodi jina lake tu na anautambua hadi kiwango cha jenasi.
summary.dg: Mtango koma ni Cucumis wa weruni, mmea unaoambala photsi, ndugu wa matango na matigiti. Pakia anaandika dzinare tu, na anaumanya hadi jenasi bahi.

about.en: Pakia identified Mtango koma only as a Cucumis species. Wild cucumbers are trailing or climbing annual or perennial herbs with rough, hairy, lobed leaves, simple tendrils and small yellow flowers. The fruits are small, often spiny or warty, and usually bitter.
about.sw: Pakia aliutambua Mtango koma kama spishi ya Cucumis tu. Matango ya porini ni mimea inayotambaa au kupanda, ya msimu mmoja au ya kudumu, yenye majani yanayokwaruza, yenye vinyweleo na pindo, mikono-shikio sahili na maua madogo ya manjano. Matunda ni madogo, mara nyingi yenye miiba au vivimbe, na kwa kawaida ni machungu.
about.dg: Pakia waumanya Mtango koma dza aina ya Cucumis bahi. Mimea ya Cucumis ya weruni ni mimea midide inayoambala photsi au inayokpwera, ambayo inakala na moyo kpwa mwaka mmwenga tu au kpwa miaka minji. Ina makodza gasigo laini, genye nyere na ganayoganyika kpwa seemu; nyuzi za kugbwirira zisizoganyika; na maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano. Matunda ni madide, mara nyinji genye miya au gasigo laini, na kpwa kawaida ni ga utsungu.

where.en: Pakia does not record where it grows. Wild Cucumis species in coastal Kenya scramble over grass and shrubs in bushland, fallow fields and farm edges.
where.sw: Pakia harekodi mahali unapoota. Spishi za Cucumis za porini katika pwani ya Kenya hutambaa juu ya nyasi na vichaka katika maeneo ya vichaka, mashamba yaliyoachwa na pembezoni mwa mashamba.
where.dg: Pakia kaandika phatu unaphomera. Aina za Cucumis za weruni pwani ya Kenya zinaambala dzulu ya nyasi na vitsaka weruni, kpwenye minda iriyorichwa na kanda-kanda ya minda.

culture.en: Pakia does not explain the name. In other Digo plant names the ending koma marks a plant as 'wild', not for people: Mtunda koma (Sideroxylon inerme) is explained as 'wild fruit', fruiting but poisonous or inedible, and Mtungudza koma is the Sodom apple, a wild relative of the eggplant.
culture.sw: Pakia haelezi jina hili. Katika majina mengine ya mimea ya Kidigo, kiishio koma huonyesha kwamba mmea ni 'wa porini', si wa watu: Mtunda koma (Sideroxylon inerme) unafafanuliwa kuwa 'tunda la porini', lenye matunda lakini yenye sumu au yasiyolika, na Mtungudza koma ni mtunguja, jamaa wa porini wa biringanya.
culture.dg: Pakia kaeleza dzina hiri. Kpwa madzina ganjina ga mimea ga Chidigo, neno ra mwisho koma rinaonyesa kukala mmea ni 'wa weruni', si wa atu: Mtunda koma (Sideroxylon inerme) unaelezwa kukala ni 'tunda ra weruni', unalavya matunda ela ni ga sumu au tagariwa; na Mtungudza koma ni *Sodom apple*, ndugu wa weruni wa mtungudza.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtango koma. Mtango is the Swahili for the cucumber plant, so the name may mean something like 'wild cucumber', but Pakia does not give its meaning. The scientific name is Cucumis sp.; the species was not determined.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtango koma. Mtango ni neno la Kiswahili la mmea wa tango, kwa hiyo huenda jina hili lina maana kama 'tango la porini', lakini Pakia hatoi maana yake. Jina la kisayansi ni Cucumis sp.; spishi yake haikubainishwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mtango koma. Mtango ni dzina ra Chiswahili ra mmea wa tango, kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rinaweza kukala na mana dza 'mtango wa weruni', ela Pakia kalavya manage. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Cucumis sp.; aina hasa taidzangbwemanyikana.
